purpose: Describe an amount or degree as far as a limit allows.
keywords: Verb plain form / potential form + だけ
You may rest as much as you like.
I brought as much as I could carry.
Please make as many copies as you need.
formation: Verb plain form / potential form + だけ
restrictions: Often pairs with a repeated verb, such as 食べたいだけ食べる.
mistake: This degree use is broader than noun + だけ meaning only.
